data.title: 史黛菈 · 宿所阳台的落日许诺
data.description: 黄昏落日将天际烧成金红，身穿绯红晚礼服的史黛菈轻轻把头靠在你的肩膀上。晚风吹拂着双马尾，她轻声诉说着想要与你并肩踏上世界巅峰、一生相随的心愿。
data.location: dormitory suite terrace at golden dusk
data.action: leaning head on partner shoulder, looking out at orange sky, gentle contented expression, breeze in red hair
data.lighting: rich fiery sunset orange glow washing over gown and skin
data.mood: unbreakable romantic vow, warm tranquility, deep soulmate bond
data.promptProse: Leaning her head on partner shoulder on a dusk balcony, Stella gazes at the crimson sunset with a serene, devoted smile.
data.animaCaption: Stella resting her head on partner shoulder watching the crimson sunset. Sunset light reflected from the terrace illuminates her face and gown.
